card.name: The 9 in 1900s years
card.fires_on: The digit 9 right after a leading 1 when a four-digit year in the 1900s is being written, mostly in citations and history about China. It sometimes fires on the next digit of such a year.

modes.label: Year digit in citations
modes.description: The 9 in a 19xx publication year in a reference list, often for Chinese journals.

modes.label: Year digit in history text
modes.description: The 9 in a 19xx year in prose about Chinese people, works or events.
